Maudgarakṛṣṇa
(is he Maudgalakṛṣṇa ?)
--C.. Candrikā on Brahmasūtrabhāṣya. dvai. Mysore N. D.

Maudgalapurāṇa
See Wint., HIL. Vol. I. p. 623b. See under Mudgalapurāṇa.

Maudgalya
ment. in Carakasaṃhitā. Authority on medicine.
See Āyurved kā Bṛhat Itihās, p. 494.

Maudgalya Ācārya
or Nāthurāma Śarman.
--Upadeśagranthāvalī.
Pt.. (with Gujarati transl.) Nirmala Press, Ahmedabad, 1905.
--Mādhava Pariśiṣṭa.
Pt.. in Hindi Electric Press, Lahore, 1929.
--Yajurvedīyasandhyādinityakarma.
Pt.. with Gujarati ṭīkā. Gujarat Press, Ahmedabad, 1913.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 1485. 1744. 2790. 3107.

Maudgalya Mayūreśvara
See Mayūreśvara of Mudgala gotra.

Maudgalyaśruti
See BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. I. p. 356.

Maudgalyasaṃhitā
q. in Baudhāyanadharmasūtra II. ii. 67. See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1206b.
Kavīndrācārya 1643.

Maudgalyāyana
q. in C. Ṭīkāsarvasva on Amarakośa. (TSS. II. p. 89). [Page208-b]

Maudgalyāyana
Bud. author. See Mogallāna Thera.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1206.; Wint. HIL. Vol. II. p. 622a.

Maudgalyāyana
--Kāraṇaprajñapti. Bud. belonging to the Abhidharma of Sarvāstivādins. Part of Prajñaptiśāstra. Sendai 4087.
--Prajñaptipadaśāstra or Prajñaptiśāstra. Bud. One of the Seven Abhidhamma texts of the Sarvāstivāda School.
Pt.. London, Bruxelles, 1914-18.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28, 629. 1178.
